g.text: III. Wage-labour and capital — the production of surplus value
class monopoly of the means of life
buys LP and MP; appropriates the product
value = SNLT to reproduce the worker
c : constant v : variable s : surplus
M - C (LP + MP) … P … C' - M'
labour process under command of capital
beyond the equivalent of v: surplus value
sole source of profit, interest, rent
The worker does not sell labour.
After the sale, living labour belongs
is what makes surplus value compatible
s/(c+v) = rate of profit — a different ratio.
Capital is not a thing. Machines are
means of production; they become capital
only as a social relation that commands
Concrete capitalist form. Determinations meet: commodity + class monopoly + labour-power as commodity + unpaid labour.
